welcome.title: Continue as
welcome.subtitle: Sign-in is handled by ForKhatri. While Milavn runs standalone, pick who you are.
welcome.headline: What’s happening around you.
welcome.lede: Real activities, real people, near you — with the trust of your community built in.
welcome.point1: Around you: today, tomorrow, this weekend
welcome.point2: Verified organizers, private attendance, no scores
welcome.point3: Ask in your own words: “yoga tomorrow morning near me”

onboarding.whereBody: This just helps us show you what’s near you — we only ever keep your locality, never an exact address.
onboarding.interestsBody: Pick at least one. You can change these any time.
onboarding.languageBody: Milavn will use this everywhere, for you.

home.title: Around you
home.emptyToday: Nothing today yet — this weekend is looking fuller.
home.emptyWeekend: Nothing this weekend yet — try widening your interests.
home.emptyLater: Nothing planned further out yet. Make something happen?

discover.emptyMap: No activities in this area — try zooming out.

detail.safetyIntro: This is marked as a higher-risk activity. A few basics:

trustExplain.forkhatri_verified: The organizer’s identity was verified by ForKhatri.
trustExplain.community_verified: The organizer has a track record of activities that actually happened.
trustExplain.partner_verified: Listed by a verified partner venue or organization.
trustExplain.community_submitted: Submitted by a community member. Not yet verified — go with people you know.

detail.notifyPrompt: Want a reminder before this starts?
detail.feedbackBody: Optional, private — it only helps organizers improve.
detail.feedbackThanks: Thanks — that stays between you and Milavn.
detail.attendeesPrivate: Who’s going is private — only the organizer sees the list.

create.title: Make something happen
create.highRisk: Physically demanding or higher-risk (shows safety basics)
create.liveBody: Share it now — a link and QR are ready.
create.cancelConfirm: Cancel this activity? Everyone who RSVP’d will be told.
create.smartPlaceholder: Describe it in one line… “badminton tomorrow 7pm at Madhapur for 8”

circles.title: Circles
circles.name: Name
circles.emptyUpcoming: Nothing planned in this circle yet — be the one who starts something.
circles.emptyMine: You’re not in any circle yet. Circles form around things you keep doing — or start one.
circles.emptyDiscover: No open circles to show yet.
circles.boardEmpty: Nothing posted yet. Plans, changes, tips — this is the place.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.empty: Nothing here yet. Things you’re going to will show up here.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.alwaysOn: Always on — safety and changes to things you’re going to

profile.title: Profile
profile.locationBody: How precisely others can see where you are. Never more than this.
profile.deleteBody: Deleting is handled by ForKhatri for every service at once. Milavn will remove its own data about you.

help.title: Help & support
help.faq1q: Who can see that I’m going?
help.faq1a: Only the organizer of that activity. Attendance is private by default.
help.faq2q: What does a trust badge mean?
help.faq2a: It tells you how an activity or organizer was verified. It is never a score and can’t be bought.
help.faq3q: I couldn’t make it. Am I penalised?
help.faq3a: No. Not showing up is never punished automatically. Reliability is one of several things the community may notice over time.
help.contactBody: Tell us what’s wrong. This goes to the Milavn team.

safety.reportBody: Tell us what’s wrong. Reports are private and reviewed by a person.
safety.submitted: Thanks. A moderator will look at this.
safety.blockBody: They won’t be able to see you in suggestions, and you won’t see them.

people.title: People
people.body: People you might already know — every suggestion says why.
people.empty: Suggestions appear as you take part in things. No swiping, no strangers.

moderation.title: Moderation queue
moderation.subject: About
moderation.confirm: Confirm {{action}}? This is recorded and audited.

state.error: Something didn’t load. It’s us, not you.
state.offline: You’re offline — showing what we have
state.profileRequired: Finish setting up your profile first.

ask.label: Ask Milavn
ask.placeholder: Ask Milavn… “badminton this weekend near me”
ask.widenedDistance: Nothing that close — here’s the same across the city.
ask.widenedWhen: Nothing on those days — here’s what’s coming up.

thread.title: Plan together
thread.private: Only people going and the organizer
thread.empty: Say hello, sort the details, share a tip — this stays with the people going.

moments.title: Moments
moments.empty: You were there — add a photo for everyone who came.

chat.title: Chats
chat.scope: You can message people you share an activity or a circle with.
chat.empty: No chats yet. Start one with someone you’re going somewhere with.
chat.nobodyYet: Join an activity or a circle first — the people there appear here.
chat.first: This stays between the people here. Say hello.
chat.cameraHint: Your camera is analysed on this device only; just a mood word is shared.
chat.cameraFailed: Camera not available — pick a mood below instead.
